sentences.en: I am sorry that I have troubled you so much.
sentences.zh: 1. 非常抱歉给你添了这么多麻烦。

sentences.en: I'm sorry to have troubled you owing to our mistake.
sentences.zh: 2. 对于我们的错误给你带来的困扰，我感到非常抱歉。

sentences.en: I can't make out why he is so much troubled.
sentences.zh: 3. 我不明白他为何如此焦虑不安。

senses.zh: 焦虑的,担忧的,混乱的,存在诸多问题的v.费神，费心( trouble的过去式和过去分词)
